title: Beyond Development: Explaining Climate Resilience Across Indian Districts
course: Big Data, SRM Institute of Science and Technology - Review 2

members.name: Sehjodh Grewal
members.responsibilities: Collect NDAP, Census 2011, IMD and boundary data; Census rates; district matching; variable selection (no imputation); grid-to-district aggregation; district-day table; orientation check; preprocessing results and error metrics (Table 1)

members.name: Deepankar
members.responsibilities: Set up Hadoop (HDFS + YARN), Hive and Spark in Colab; HDFS zones and data loading; storage report (Table 2); MapReduce yearly climate indices and scalability; Hive 30-year baseline and join; Spark k-means climate regimes (Table 3)
members.completion: In progress (full 1901–2024 rainfall in HDFS for Review 3)

members.name: Devanshu Kumar
members.responsibilities: Design and train B-ACPN (random-forest tree stage, attention, residual MLP, development gate, 5-network ensemble); MC Dropout and conformal uncertainty; model card (Table 4); ablation; climate-push analysis (Table 6)

members.name: Tanmay Singh
members.responsibilities: Compare B-ACPN with Logistic Regression, Random Forest, GBT, Linear SVM (Spark MLlib) and MLP on the same folds; all metrics, confidence intervals, significance; effect of preprocessing on the models (Table 5); result figures; slides
members.completion: In progress (Spark MLlib re-run in Colab; final report)
